Specify pipeline execution options

Source: R/pipeline_options.R
execution_options.Rd

Configure rebuild behavior, import progress, and continuation after stage failures.

Usage

execution_options(
  skip_on_error = FALSE,
  show_progress = TRUE,
  overwrite = FALSE
)

Arguments

skip_on_error

Logical. Continue to subsequent pipeline stages after a failure. Default: FALSE. Required raw-transformation failures always stop run_one_source().

show_progress

Logical. Display progress during cohort import. Default: TRUE. The optional raw-cache stage uses the same setting.

overwrite

Logical. Rebuild raw caches, cohort Parquet files, and loaded cohort tables when requested. Default: FALSE, which allows those stages to reuse complete outputs. This setting does not control whether concept SQL or harmonization rebuilds their tables.

Value

A named list of the supplied options, suitable for the execution argument of run_one_source() and compatible direct stage functions.

Details

Use these options with run_one_source() or a direct stage that accepts the relevant settings.

Only explicitly supplied arguments are included in the result, including explicit NULL values. Omitted settings use the defaults of the receiving function. An empty options list therefore leaves its defaults unchanged.

See also

pipeline_options, run_one_source()

Examples

execution_options(show_progress = FALSE)
#> $show_progress
#> [1] FALSE
#> 
execution_options(overwrite = TRUE)
#> $overwrite
#> [1] TRUE
#>
